annotation.title_clean: ロボティクス・メカトロニクスの現状と展望 ―ロボティクス・メカトロニクス部門の活動実績とPSからの将来への期待
annotation.title_en: Current status and prospect on robotics and mechatronics: Prospect based on activity report and policy statement of the Robotics and Mechatronics Division
annotation.venue: 日本機械学会2015年度年次大会講演論文集
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper from the JSME Robotics and Mechatronics Division reviewing the 2014 robotics boom in Japan (Robot Revolution, Fukushima decommissioning, Robot White Paper) and the division's five-year policy statement. It promotes social implementation, youth training, internationalisation and 'community-based robotics' with shared standards such as RT-Middleware.
key_provisions_or_claims: 2014 saw robots come to the fore in Japan, driven by the Robot Revolution initiative and the first Robot White Paper.
Robots entered Fukushima reactor containment investigations; long-term decommissioning requires talent development.
Division policy statement prioritises internationalisation, youth involvement, industry ties and visible social contribution.
Technology roadmaps to be rolled over every three years to guide robotics and mechatronics.
Proposes community-based service robotics using common standards (RT-Middleware, RSNP) possibly leading to international standards.
